name: don-t-check-social-media
description: A browser extension to block social media distractions.

scripts.build: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path dist; Copy-Item -Path src/* -Destination dist -Recurse"
scripts.package: npm run build && bestzip extension.zip dist/*
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build && bestzip abstinence-chrome.zip dist/*
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build && bestzip abstinence-firefox.zip dist/*
